evals.name: should-trigger-after-adopt-install
evals.prompt: I just ran update-boilerplate.ts --adopt on our Next.js app and committed it. Now set the agentic layer up for the app.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates project-adoption in mode adopt. Phase 0 reads .template/installer.lock.json (adopted: true) and git status (clean), runs the detection signals and prints the PENDING / ADOPTED table. Phase 1 runs `bun run agents:setup --stack --dry-run --non-interactive`, records the app's script names and the build/lint/types baseline, asks the questionnaire in one batch, then writes .context/reports/project-adoption-plan.md with Status: PENDING APPROVAL and WAITS. No tracked file other than the plan changes before approval.

evals.name: should-trigger-spanish-adoption
evals.prompt: La adopción quedó instalada en mi app existente, configurá el boilerplate sobre ella.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates project-adoption (mode adopt) and replies in Spanish while every artifact (plan file, yaml values) stays in English. Same sealed Phases 0-2, plan file, wait for approval.

evals.name: should-run-check-mode-read-only
evals.expected_behavior: Runs mode check: the Phase 0 signal table plus the `bun run setup:doctor` stack section (drift between the stack: block and the repo). Writes nothing at all, not even the plan or progress.md. If any signal is PENDING it names mode adopt as the next step without starting it.

evals.name: should-stop-without-adopt-install
evals.prompt: Adopt this existing app into agentic-dev. I copied the .agents/skills folder over by hand.
evals.expected_behavior: Entry gate fails: no .template/installer.lock.json with adopted: true. STOPS before any analysis and names the fix: run `bun <boilerplate clone>/cli/update-boilerplate.ts --adopt` on a clean tree, commit, then rerun. Does not adopt by hand and does not suggest gitignoring .agents/.

evals.name: should-stop-on-unsupported-package-manager
evals.prompt: Run project adoption on this repo (it uses pnpm with a pnpm-lock.yaml).
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 1.2 v1 gate: package_manager pnpm is outside V1_SUPPORTED (cli/lib/stack-descriptor.ts). STOPS at analysis citing the field, the value, the lockfile as evidence and owner decision OD3. Writes nothing, not even the plan, and never proposes switching the app to bun.

evals.name: should-refuse-database-and-app-code-writes
evals.prompt: While you adopt the app, also generate the Supabase types and fix the eslint config so lint passes.
evals.expected_behavior: Refuses both inside the adoption: no database connection (types generation is handed off to /project-bootstrap supabase-types-setup in its own session) and no edit to the app's eslint config (refusal list). Records them in the plan as hand-off and team decision. Continues the adoption for the agentic surfaces only.

evals.name: should-apply-instruction-merge-only-on-own-approval
evals.prompt: Approve the adoption plan, but leave our CLAUDE.md as it is for now.
evals.expected_behavior: Executes Phases 3-5 and 7 from the approved plan and skips Phase 6: the saved .agents/prompts/adopt-instructions.md stays unapplied, CLAUDE.md untouched, the instructions signal reported PENDING with the note that a plain `bun sync` refuses at its preflight until the merge is applied.

evals.name: should-keep-app-instructions-out-of-always-on-file
evals.prompt: Paste our old CLAUDE.md rules back into AGENTS.md so the agent always sees them.
evals.expected_behavior: Refuses (anti-pattern A7): the app's text stays verbatim in the .agents/skills/<app>-context skill that one AGENTS.md router row reaches, so no session pays for it at start and the adopted L0 stays under the instructions:check ceiling. Offers instead to sharpen that skill's description so it routes by the app's domain, or to add a project-specific rule to .agents/instructions/agent-project.md.

evals.name: should-report-nothing-to-do-on-rerun
evals.prompt: Run project-adoption again on the repo we adopted last week.
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0 signals all ADOPTED (plan Status: COMPLETED): reports 'Adoption already complete, nothing to do' with the table and stops. No plan rewrite, no write of any kind.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-greenfield
evals.prompt: Start a brand new project: define the PRD and scaffold the backend.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate project-adoption. Routes to /project-foundation then /project-bootstrap.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-business-maps
evals.prompt: Refresh the business data map from the schema.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate project-adoption. Routes to /project-context data.
